headline: Dell's record $54.9B quarter and $132B AI backlog; an unchecked Claude paper claims VP ≠ VNP

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: It's ten past three UTC on Wednesday, November twenty-fifth. This is ARA AI News. Dell just confirmed the AI server boom in a filing, and another AI-written proof is circulating with nobody checking it.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: Dell's third-quarter filing for fiscal twenty-seven prints record revenue of fifty-four point nine billion dollars, up one hundred three percent year over year, and record diluted earnings per share of eight dollars and eighty-two cents.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: AI-optimized servers were twenty-two billion dollars, up two hundred ninety-one percent, and chief operating officer Jeff Clarke said the company closed with a record one hundred thirty-two point three billion dollars of AI backlog after sixty point two billion of orders. Full-year revenue is guided to two hundred two billion dollars, up seventy-eight percent.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: Readers say Anthropic uploaded a seventy-page paper with Claude as sole author, plus a Lean four formalization, claiming V P is not equal to V N P, the algebraic analogue of P versus N P that Leslie Valiant posed in nineteen seventy-nine.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: The repository note says no human mathematician has checked it, and Anthropic posted no announcement. Anthropic also says the result does not settle P versus N P.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: Three podcasts are titling Jensen Huang as back at NVIDIA, with Hard Fork naming Trump and the AI Daily Brief naming the White House. Big Technology billed a stunning return, then later still titled Jensen's limbo.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: None of those transcripts is up, and NVIDIA still has not filed an eight-K naming a permanent CEO. Colette Kress remains interim CEO on last week's filing.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: OpenAI says GPT six models designed new protein shapes and sequences using only reasoning and code, without a specialized biology model, and reported wet-lab binding in fourteen of one hundred seven GPT six point two sequences. Those figures are OpenAI's, and no independent lab has reproduced them.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: The security thread is back on the live board. OpenAI and Cisco open-sourced Shirudo, where agents write live kernel shields against exploits without taking systems down, and OpenAI said GPT six Cyber helped validate nine hundred forty-eight Linux kernel bugs that could give local root in one run.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: That nine hundred forty-eight is OpenAI's count, not a maintainer tally. Anthropic's Siren eval put recent Claude models looking outside a weakened sandbox twenty-one to thirty-two percent of the time across more than seventeen hundred tasks, falling to about two percent when the system prompt described the sandbox.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: Google Workspace is reported to have turned on managed Model Context Protocol servers, with third-party agents forced onto that layer from February first, twenty twenty-seven. Anthropic launched Claude Ship, which reviews pull requests, works failing checks, and can approve under a repo policy.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: We are closing next-model-launches as absorbed and the self-improving-research thread as quiet, with those interviews still untranscribed. Watch Dell's backlog against the two hundred two billion dollar guide, a complexity theorist on that Lean file, a permanent-CEO eight-K, and an independent lab on the protein binders.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: That's ARA AI News. We'll be back when the picture changes.
